   MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  CITY OF NORWALK HISTORICAL HERITAGE COMMISSION
  March 25, 2024

Recreation Supervisor, Pati Escano, called the meeting to order at 4:36.p.m. Commission
members present were: Marcelle Greenidge, Alex Henandez, Claudia Carolina Pavon,
Margaret Scantlebury, and Ericka Hidalgo. Staff present were Recreation Supervisor Pati
Escano and Recreation Leader III, Juanita Porras.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES
Commissioner Claudia Carolina Pavon moved to approve the minutes of the February
26, 2024 meeting. Commissioner Marcelle Greenidge seconded. Minutes of the meeting
were accepted.

OLD BUSINESS
Recreation Supervisor, Pati Escano mentioned new ideas for the monthly tours,
incorporate how seasons and holidays were celebrated in the 1800’s. Some ideas that
were presented; butter making, churning of ice cream and creating old fashioned dolls.

Commissioner Marcelle Greenige inquired about the Rose Garden Celebration. Pati
mentioned Rose Ceremony for Polly Haack and Marie Carter but also would like to include
Pat Martin for all her years of service as commissioner, docent, and Friends of the Hargitt
Museum.

STAFF COMMENTS
Recreation presentations Supervisor Pati Escano presented on Teatime at the Hargitt
House, May 18, 1-4pm, Pati asked for ideas as giveaways for Teatime. Idease presented
were teaspoons with teabags, cookies and etc. Pati will send an invite to the Red Hat
Society. Pati Escano mentioned Easter Event probability of moving event due to rain.
Event will be moved to Arts and Sports Complex if weather continues to be a factor.

NEW BUSINESS
Recreation Supervisor Pati Escano Rose Garden Celebration for Marie Carter, Polly
Haack and Pat Martin will receive a plague placed by a rosebush honoring them.
Display pictures of the ladies during their time as docents, ceremony and pick a rose
bush dedicated to each one. Recreation Supervisor Pati Escano gave a update on
Sproul Museum roofing project. Sproul Roof renovations report presented through a
PowerPoint. One bid was reserved with following results included all specs of the work.
Recreation Supervisor Pati Escano indicated breakdown for Sproul Museum is on
report, cost is $59,875.00 with a condingency. Project has begun at the Sproul House.
Recreatio Supervisor Pati Escano will inquire if report is a public document. Estimate
completion time for projects is thirty days.

COMMISSIONER’S COMMENTS
Commissioner Ericka Hidalgo requested designated parking for those attending
Marcelle Greenidge added to Teatime to have teasets on display during event.

Margaret Scantlebury made a suggestions to have a Harp playing during the event.
Margaret Scantlebury inquired on the breakdown of the cost. Margaret Scantlebury
inquired on the breakdown of the project.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
The next scheduled meeting will take place on Monday, April 29, 2024 at 4:30p.

ADJOURNMENT

With no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 5:14p.m.

Respectfully submitted,

____________________________________

Commission Chair Claudia Pavon
